description: Use this when the user asks which companies are accredited e-invoicing service providers (ASPs) in the UAE, whether a named company is accredited, or for the official ASP list. The UAE Ministry of Finance register of accredited e-invoicing service providers (ASPs): company names, accreditation numbers and websites as published, with the date the register was last updated, the date it was checked and the official link. The register grows as more providers are accredited, so point the user to the source page before they appoint one. Rows keep the register's order: it is not a ranking, and no provider is recommended. Pass search to look up one company by name. Do not use it to choose or rank a provider: it lists the register as published.

search.description: Part of a company name, to check whether it is on the register.
